testimonies.name: Mrs Adeyemi
testimonies.title: Carry Your Baby
testimonies.testimony: I joined the Carry Your Baby program online last October because I live in Canada. I had been married for 5 years without a child. Doctors told us that our case was complex. I joined the program online and was present throughout despite the time difference between Nigeria and Canada. I got pregnant shortly after that and delivered a healthy baby boy in July.

testimonies.name: Mrs Dominic
testimonies.title: Carry Your Baby
testimonies.testimony: I attended last year's October Carry Your Baby program. I came out on behalf of my sister who was having problems with childbearing. I believed God for identical twin girls. After the program, I told her to expect two girls who would be identical. Thank God, she delivered identical twin girls this August.

testimonies.name: Mrs A
testimonies.title: Carry Your Baby
testimonies.testimony: I attended last year's October Carry Your Baby program and I am presently pregnant and expecting my baby.

testimonies.name: Mrs J
testimonies.title: Carry Your Baby
testimonies.testimony: Doctors said I have multiple fibroids and hormone imbalances, but I attended last year's October Carry Your Baby program. Thank God, I am presently pregnant and expecting my baby anytime from now.
